map.W 前数字管低温启动，越小越抗寒；W 后数字是 100℃ 运动黏度，越大油膜越厚: The number before W governs cold starting; smaller resists cold better. The number after W is kinematic viscosity at 100°C; larger means a thicker oil film and better protection in heavy duty, but also higher consumption and cold-start drag.
map.带 GPF/DPF 的涡轮直喷机烧掉的机油灰分无法再生，会堵塞捕集器、缩短再生周: In turbo direct-injection engines with GPF/DPF, ash from burnt oil cannot be regenerated away and clogs the trap while shortening regeneration intervals, so ACEA C-series or manufacturer-approved low-ash oils are required.

map.老旧高里程车考虑略增黏度或高里程专用油，补偿间隙增大导致的压力下降。: Older high-mileage engines can use slightly thicker oil or a high-mileage formula to compensate for pressure loss from wider clearances.
map.涡轮增压直喷机按厂家要求选用低灰分（如 C 系列）机油，保护颗粒捕集器。: Turbo direct-injection engines need manufacturer-specified low-ash oils (e.g. C series) to protect the particulate filter.
map.SAE 5W-30 中 W 前数字 5 表示低温流动性（对应约 −30℃ 可泵送: In SAE 5W-30 the 5 before W marks low-temperature fluidity (pumpable down to about −30°C) and the 30 the viscosity grade at 100°C; severely cold northern regions choose 0W oils, while tropical or high-mileage engines step up to higher high-temperature grades such as 10W-40. Follow the service manual rather than guessing.
map.W 前后的数字分别指什么？: What do the numbers before and after W mean?
map.W（Winter）前的数字代表低温性能，越小越耐冷启动；W 后的数字代表 100: W stands for Winter: the number before it rates low-temperature performance, so lower resists cold starting better. The number after it is viscosity at 100°C, so higher means a thicker film. Together they describe behavior across the whole temperature range, and getting either wrong hurts starting or protection.
map.涡轮车为什么强调低灰分？: Why is low ash stressed for turbo engines?
map.涡轮直喷机常配 GPF/DPF 颗粒捕集器，高灰分机油燃烧生成的灰分易堵塞捕集器: Turbo direct-injection engines usually carry a GPF/DPF trap, and ash from high-ash oil clogs it and shortens regeneration intervals, so ACEA C-series or approved low-ash oils are commonly required. Ordinary naturally aspirated engines are not bound by this, but should still meet the manual specification.
map.推荐结果为按气候与车况推算的合理区间，实际请以随车保养手册为准: The recommendation is a sensible band derived from climate and engine condition; always follow the service manual
